prompt: I need to store my API keys for the project. Can you help me set up the vault?

assertions.name: checks-gitignore
assertions.description: Reads .gitignore to check for vault/Config/ pattern

assertions.name: adds-gitignore-entry
assertions.description: Adds vault/Config/ to .gitignore if not present

assertions.name: verifies-vault-directory
assertions.description: Checks that vault/Config/ directory exists or creates it

assertions.name: explains-workflow
assertions.description: Explains how keys will be stored and referenced
